source_json_codec: pm.goal.certified_producer_source_json.v1 as fully specified in protocol.md; exact integers and no floats
native_source_json_codec: pm.goal.certification_source_json.v1 unchanged in whole native-v7 commitment-domains.json
selector_sha256: SHA-256 exact original physical bytes at the named key under that family's original codec; new compact family wrappers use messagepack_canonical, never source-JSON substituted for physical bytes
prepared_intent_sha256: SHA-256 exact full prospective StorageIntent wrapper physical bytes, constructed from entire Intent. No Intent or source field contains this hash or enclosing Prepared result.
whole_producer25_sha256: SHA-256 source_json_codec of entire producer-owned 25-field candidate, including schema_id/schema_version/event_id/replay_policy and all required-present nulls

producer_semantic_digest.codec: RFC8785 canonical JSON followed by SHA-256, unchanged CV-1029

new_phase_commitments.whole_first_append_receipt_sha256: source_json_codec over complete genuinely issued first AppendReceipt; does not replace original receipt owner commitments
new_phase_commitments.original_full_value_result_sha256: source_json_codec over complete original three-field full_value_result
new_phase_commitments.original_event_value_sha256: the genuine original_event_value_commitment's original stored-value SHA field under its original canonical MessagePack domain
new_phase_commitments.active_group_sha256: source_json_codec over complete original active_durable_group; does not replace original group_digest
new_phase_commitments.all_member_custody_sha256: source_json_codec over ordered complete AppendEvidence.members, including each full Event, custody and full_value_result; committed hash does not retain those mutable/full source values
new_phase_commitments.whole_native_published_union_sha256: source_json_codec over whole authentic PublishedWorkflow result, including its complete result/origin/lineage/current at original issuance; stored hash does not retain full old native values
new_phase_commitments.whole_post_native_readback_sha256: source_json_codec over ordered array [complete actual PublishedWorkflow, entire OriginalEventPrerequisite, entire AppendEvidence] at genuine post-native held readback
new_phase_commitments.whole_release_current_sources_sha256: source_json_codec over ordered array [whole OriginalCertificationSource as originally held, whole unchanged current Goal argument, whole genuine DurableStandardRead, whole original producer source, whole IdentityResult, entire post-native current PublishedWorkflow, entire current OriginalEventPrerequisite, entire AppendEvidence] with phase-aware independent currentness checks
